name: Kaguya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood furniture shop (Nobara Kagu): an assembly-fee change notice, a first day working part-time, an hours-and-fees guide, a delivery reservation system's switch from phone to app, a first-timer's manners guide, a lesson in rephrasing the difference between two furniture types simply, a delivery mix-up and the lesson it teaches, the shop's history of switching from a paper order ledger to an app, a warranty-and-free-adjustment-ticket guide, a column on the debate behind posting customer room photos on SNS, a hybrid paper-stamp-plus-app membership guide, a reflection on balancing efficiency and care as mass-produced flat-pack furniture spreads, and a fortieth-anniversary report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
